## 6. Special Relaxation to visit NER, J&K, Ladakh and A&N  
A scheme allowing Government servants to travel by air to North East Region (NER), Jammu and Kashmir (J&K), Ladakh and Andaman and Nicobar Islands (A&N) is extended for a further period of two years, with  
effect from 26th September, 2022 till 25th September, 2024 as under:  
- 1.
- LTC for visiting NER, J&K, Ladakh and A&N in lieu of a Home Town LTC.
